title: Refund processing
text: For Example Air, an approved involuntary full refund is returned to the original payment method within seven business days after approval. The refund team sends a confirmation email when processing starts. A bank may require additional posting time. The passenger must not be promised an exact bank posting date.

title: Involuntary rebooking
text: After an Example Air schedule disruption, an agent may request one alternative flight on the same route. Rebooking depends on seat availability and current carrier authorization. The agent must confirm the available flight before issuing a replacement ticket. Eligibility alone does not reserve a seat.

title: Airline cancellations
text: When Example Air cancels a flight, support records the cancellation notice and offers a review of refund or replacement travel options. The passenger chooses which option to request. Support must check the relevant fare and disruption rules before making any change. Cancellation does not automatically issue a refund.

title: Missing baggage
text: A passenger whose checked suitcase does not arrive must report the missing baggage at the arrival airport baggage desk before leaving. The desk creates a property irregularity report and supplies a reference number. The passenger should retain bag tags and follow the tracing instructions supplied by the baggage team.

title: Online check-in window
text: Example Air online check-in opens 24 hours before the scheduled departure and closes two hours before departure. Passengers provide their booking reference and surname in the check-in portal. Airport document checks may still be required. A completed online check-in does not waive the boarding gate deadline.

title: Mobility assistance
text: Wheelchair and mobility assistance requests should reach Example Air at least 48 hours before departure. Support records the assistance category and airport transfer needs. Late requests are forwarded to the accessibility team for a feasibility check. An agent must not request medical information that is unnecessary for arranging assistance.

title: Passenger name corrections
text: Minor spelling errors in an Example Air passenger name require a name-correction review. The agent compares the booking against the travel document, records the proposed correction and contacts the ticketing desk. Tickets cannot be transferred to another person through a name correction. The ticketing desk confirms any applicable charge.

title: Compensation review
text: A compensation request is handled separately from a ticket refund. The Example Air claims team reviews the disruption cause, journey details and applicable requirements. Agents must not infer compensation eligibility from a refund prediction. The passenger receives a claim reference after submitting the required information.

title: Duplicate payment charges
text: For a possible duplicate card charge, support checks whether both entries are settled transactions or whether one is a temporary authorization. The payments team investigates two settled charges for the same booking. Support records transaction dates and masked card details only. Full card numbers must not be collected in chat.

title: Travel vouchers
text: An Example Air travel voucher is optional when an eligible passenger has another available remedy. Support explains the voucher expiry date and usage restrictions before obtaining explicit acceptance. A voucher cannot be substituted for a requested cash refund without confirmation. Unused voucher balances follow the terms shown on the voucher.

title: Missed connections
text: For a protected Example Air connection affected by an earlier flight disruption, the agent checks the complete ticket and requests a suitable onward connection. Separate tickets require an individual review and are not automatically protected. A revised connection must respect the airport minimum connection time and seat availability.

title: Updating contact details
text: A passenger may request an update to the email address or telephone number linked to an Example Air booking after identity verification. Support confirms the new contact details by reading them back and sends an update confirmation. A contact-detail change does not modify the passenger name or ticket ownership.

title: Expired refund processing
text: The old refund processing target was ninety business days. This expired fictional document is a metadata-filtering test.

title: Different carrier refund processing
text: Alternate Air refunds are reviewed by a different refund team. This fictional carrier has its own processing policy.
